significance: A Paadal Petra Sthalam within Madurai city, first raised by Pandya kings and later expanded under the Nayaks and Sethupathis, with a Somaskanda image of note.
story: A carpenter's wedge ('aappu') is said to have turned into a Shivalinga so the Pandya king Solandhagan could cross the flooded Vaigai, naming both temple and deity.
